# Dreamer's Bible College

> Dreamer's Bible College (DBC) is a church-integrated Bible college in Austin, Texas, and a ministry of Dreamer's Church. It offers 1-year, 2-year, and 4-year pathways that combine biblical teaching, leadership development, and hands-on ministry experience, with full-time and part-time options. DBC is now enrolling for Spring 2027.

Last updated: 2026-11-27

## Key facts

- Name: Dreamer's Bible College (also written "DBC")
- Type: Church-integrated Bible college; a ministry of Dreamer's Church (https://dreamerschurch.com)
- Location: 10700 Anderson Mill Rd, Austin, TX 78750, USA
- Phone: (512) 537-5871
- Email: admin@dreamers.church
- Website: https://www.dreamersbiblecollege.com/
- Current enrollment term: Spring 2027
- Pathways: 1-year, 2-year, and 4-year
- Enrollment options: full-time and part-time (part-time can be up to 50% online, with at least 50% in-person attendance, subject to course availability and approval)
- Ministry focuses: Creative, Youth, Worship, and Kids
- Who it is for: high school graduates, young adults, church members, emerging leaders, and adults who want to grow in Scripture, calling, leadership, and practical ministry. Students do not have to be pursuing vocational ministry.

## Tuition

- Full-time (12 to 16 credit hours): $2,800 per semester, flat rate. Credits beyond 16 hours are $200 per additional credit hour.
- Part-time: $250 per credit hour.
- Required textbooks and course materials are included in tuition.
- Scholarships or financial assistance may be available depending on pathway and enrollment status. Contact admissions for details.

## Preview Day

- Next Preview Day: Monday, February 15, 2027, at Dreamer's Church, 10700 Anderson Mill Rd, Austin, TX 78750.
- Visitors sit in on a real class, meet current students and leaders, and can ask about programs, tuition, and scholarships. Parents are welcome.
- Details and registration: https://www.dreamersbiblecollege.com/preview-day/

## Spring 2027 courses

Covenants (3 credits), Holy Spirit (2), Local Church (2), Decision Making (2), Social Responsibility (3, online), Personal Discipline (2), Pulpit Ministry (2), Find Community (2), Make A Difference (2), and Practicum (1). Classes meet Monday through Thursday. Full times and descriptions: https://www.dreamersbiblecollege.com/schedule/
